title: Treeview
description: x-treeview builds a collapsible tree (role="tree") from a JSON array of nodes. A node with children gets a ▶ toggle that opens and closes them, and each level is indented 1.5rem.

items.description: JSON array of nodes, each `{"name": "...", "children": [...]}`; children is optional and nests the same way.

_metadata.derivedFrom: navigation.js treeview() — every property here is one the behavior reads
